key.name: panel-box
key.description: Top bar section holding the toolbox indicator: left, center or right.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Lower values sit further left within the chosen section; values past the last item land on the far end.

key.name: enable-vitals
key.description: Show CPU/memory/network load on the panel and details in the menu.

key.name: enable-lock-keys
key.description: Show lock key state on the panel with toggles in the menu.

key.name: enable-clipboard
key.description: Keep a text clipboard history and expose it in the menu.

key.name: enable-tray
key.description: Claim org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher and host indicator icons. The legacy XEmbed tray is controlled separately by legacy-tray-enabled.

key.name: enable-notification-autohide
key.description: Tear down a notification banner after a countdown instead of leaving it on the top bar. The notification itself is kept and moves into the calendar notification list.

key.name: notification-hide-delay
key.description: Seconds a notification banner stays fully shown before it is collapsed into the notification list.

key.name: auto-hide-critical-notifications
key.description: By default critical-urgency notifications keep their banner until dismissed by hand.

key.name: enable-player-fix
key.description: Show the player state in the menu and kill a deadlocked video player (GNOME Showtime) after it stops answering on D-Bus. A frozen player keeps owning org.gnome.Showtime, so every later launch opens nothing until that process is gone.

key.name: player-auto-fix
key.description: While the player is running, ping it every player-watch-interval seconds and kill it once three probes in a row go unanswered. Off leaves only the menu row as the manual trigger.

key.name: player-watch-interval
key.description: Seconds between liveness probes while the player is running.

key.name: update-interval
key.description: How often (in seconds) vitals numbers refresh.

key.name: max-entry-length
key.description: Longer clipboard text is truncated to this many characters before being stored.

key.name: show-clipboard-osd
key.summary: Show OSD toast on clipboard copy
key.description: Pop an on-screen toast whenever new content lands on the clipboard.

key.name: paste-on-select
key.description: Simulate Shift+Insert after selecting a history entry instead of only setting the clipboard.

key.name: history-include-images
key.description: Store copied images alongside text. Screenshots only ever publish image/* mimetypes, so without this they are never recorded.

key.name: clipboard-persist
key.summary: Keep the clipboard history across sessions
key.description: Mirror the history to ~/.local/state/gnome-toolbox/clipboard so a logout or reboot does not clear it. Turning this off deletes the saved snapshot immediately. Privacy mode always wipes it.

key.name: normalize-screenshots
key.description: Rewrite clipboard images that declare an image mimetype but carry other bytes into genuine PNG, so pasting into apps that trust the declared type works.

key.name: normalize-shortcut
key.description: Key combination that converts the current clipboard image in place. Empty list disables the shortcut.

key.name: normalize-on-copy
key.description: Convert a mislabelled screenshot the moment it lands on the clipboard, without pressing the shortcut. Takes over clipboard ownership right after the capturer writes it.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Icon size in pixel, 0 follows the panel size.

key.name: compact-mode-enabled
key.description: Reduces the spacing between indicators.

key.name: tray-pos
key.description: Set where the icon tray should appear.

key.name: custom-icons
key.description: Replace any icons with custom icons from themes.
